Question: Which of the candidate cows (Cow03, Cow02, Cow06) is the boxed cow? Compare tag colour and which ear, white markings, body size/shape. Also label her behaviour.

input.evidence: Close-up views at 0, -10 s and +20 s, and whole-pen frames at -30, -10, +10 and +30 s. The boxed cow is lying on her chest with her legs out, at the far left of the pen, away from the main group. She has a pink tag hanging from one ear and a small yellow button tag in the other. No white markings are visible, and she looks like an average-sized cow. At the case time her head is tipped back with her mouth open, which looks like a short stretch or yawn. In the other frames her head is up and calm, and she stays in the same spot. The chew check found a dominant frequency of 0.38 Hz. That is below the 0.7-1.4 Hz cud-chewing range, so she was not ruminating. All three candidate reference crops were unavailable, so I could not compare tags or body shape against Cow03, Cow02 or Cow06.
input.self_check: I confirmed she was lying across about 60 seconds of whole-pen frames and checked for cud chewing with chew_check, so I'm fairly sure of the behaviour. I'm not giving an identity because there were no reference images to match against. The tracker's pick of Cow03, by a small margin, is untested. A reference crop showing which cow wears a pink dangle tag plus a yellow button tag would settle it. Her ears looked normal, and one open-mouth frame is not enough to call laboured breathing. She is lying apart from the group, but resting cows often do that, so I did not list it as a sign. If the herd's tags were known, the answer could change to one of the candidates.
